landing.title: Hard topics are no longer a barrier
landing.subtitle: For students in Fergana: learn from peers, work step by step with AI Ustoz, then connect with a teacher if needed. Understand instead of copying.
landing.privacy: Your data is used only for learning.
landing.problem_class: Large classes leave little time for each student
landing.problem_groups: Telegram groups can be disorganized and unsafe
landing.problem_answers: AI bots give ready answers without helping students learn
landing.stepText1: Start with similar questions explained by peers, with clear steps for each solution.
landing.stepText2: AI Ustoz explains one small step and checks your understanding. Ask for a simpler explanation whenever needed.
landing.stepText3: Still stuck? Book a short online lesson with a teacher in Fergana.
landing.rewardText_fire: Build a habit of learning every day.
landing.rewardText_points: Earn points by understanding problems and helping friends.
landing.rewardText_ranking: Follow your progress and set new learning goals.
landing.teacherText: Earn from online lessons and find new students for your offline courses.
landing.modelTitle: Free for students, opportunities for teachers
landing.modelText: Planned model: free access for students, with teachers paid per session through local education budgets (Hokimiyat / Barkamol Avlod) and sponsor companies. Teachers can also gain offline students.
landing.safetyText: Independent access from grade 8; grade 7 and below need parental confirmation.
landing.finalText: Ask one question. Understand one small step. Your bridge to knowledge starts here.
